lessons.title: What Is Easter?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe one way families celebrate Easter.
lessons.starter_activity: Show pictures of Easter symbols (eggs, bunnies, chicks).
lessons.main_activity: Discuss simply what Easter celebrates and how different families mark it (eggs, egg hunts, spring, for Christian families the Easter story).
key_questions: What symbols do you see at Easter?

differentiation.extension: Compare to another festival learned about this year

lessons.assessment_notes: Note cultural awareness — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap key Easter facts and symbols.
lessons.home_link: Talk about Easter traditions in your family.

lessons.title: Decorating Easter Eggs
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to decorate an egg shape using patterns and colour.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at examples of decorated eggs.
lessons.main_activity: Children decorate a paper or hard-boiled egg template using paint, patterns, and colour.
resources_needed: Egg templates or real eggs, paint, craft materials
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe pattern-making and fine motor control — evidence for EAD.1/MATHS.2.
lessons.home_link: Decorate an egg or picture of an egg together at home.

lessons.title: Story Time: An Easter-Themed Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer a simple comprehension question about the story.
lessons.main_activity: Read a simple Easter/spring-themed story, pausing for comprehension questions.

differentiation.extension: Answer in full sentences with reasoning

lessons.plenary: Discuss favourite part of the story.
lessons.home_link: Share an Easter or spring story with family.

lessons.title: Easter Around the World
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recognise that Easter/spring festivals look different in different places.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a simple world map.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss how Easter or spring celebrations differ slightly around the world (different foods, traditions).
resources_needed: World map, Easter tradition picture cards from different countries
key_questions: What is different about this country's Easter tradition?

differentiation.extension: Locate countries on the map and compare 2+

lessons.assessment_notes: Note broadened cultural/geographic awareness — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.home_link: Find a country on a map and imagine its spring traditions.

lessons.title: Easter Bonnet/Basket Craft
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to construct and decorate an Easter bonnet or basket.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at examples of Easter bonnets/baskets.
lessons.main_activity: Children make and decorate a simple Easter bonnet (paper plate) or basket (card) using craft materials.
resources_needed: Paper plates or card baskets, craft materials
key_questions: What will you put inside your basket?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe fine motor and creative choice — evidence for EAD.1/PD.2.
lessons.plenary: Parade bonnets or display baskets together.
lessons.home_link: Wear/use your craft for an Easter activity at home.

lessons.title: Writing 'Happy Easter' Cards
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to attempt to write a simple greeting message.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at an example greeting card.
lessons.main_activity: Children design and attempt to write 'Happy Easter' on a card using known phonics sounds.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note purposeful writing attempt — evidence for LIT.3.
lessons.plenary: Share Easter cards with a partner.
lessons.home_link: Make a greeting card for someone at home.

lessons.title: Spring Is Here: Signs of the Season
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe one sign that spring has arrived.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what children have noticed changing outside recently.
lessons.main_activity: Go on a short walk or look at pictures to spot signs of spring (buds, blossom, birds nesting, warmer weather).
resources_needed: Spring sign picture cards, or outdoor walk
key_questions: What sign of spring can you see?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note seasonal observation skill — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.home_link: Look for signs of spring on a walk together.

lessons.title: Easter Egg Hunt Movement Game
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to move and search cooperatively during a themed game.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss how an egg hunt works.
lessons.main_activity: Class or small-group egg hunt (using decorated eggs from Monday or plastic eggs) around the outdoor/indoor space, practising cooperative searching.
resources_needed: Eggs to hide, baskets from Tuesday
key_questions: Where did you find your egg?

differentiation.extension: Add clues or a counting challenge to the hunt

lessons.assessment_notes: Note cooperative play and gross motor movement — evidence for EAD.2/PSED.3/PD.1.
lessons.plenary: Count eggs found together as a class.
lessons.home_link: Have a mini egg or treasure hunt at home.

lessons.title: Retelling an Easter Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to retell the story's key events in sequence.
lessons.main_activity: Using picture cards, children retell the story sequence using sequencing words.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note sequencing and retelling ability — evidence for LIT.1/CL.2.
lessons.plenary: One group retells to the class.
lessons.home_link: Retell the story to someone at home.

lessons.title: Giving and Kindness at Easter
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe why giving/sharing is part of the Easter tradition for many families.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the giving theme from Diwali/Christmas earlier in the year.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss how sharing eggs/treats and spending time with family is part of Easter for many, and think of a kind giving act.
key_questions: What could you share with someone?
How does sharing make you feel?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note prosocial and reflective thinking — evidence for UTW.2/PSED.3.
lessons.plenary: Class list of kind giving ideas.
lessons.home_link: Do one kind 'giving' act for someone at home this week.

lessons.title: Easter Song and Dance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to sing an Easter/spring themed song with actions.
lessons.starter_activity: Listen to a simple Easter/spring song.
lessons.main_activity: Learn simple actions/movements to an Easter or spring song, performing with confidence.
key_questions: What action goes with this line?
How does the music make you feel?

differentiation.extension: Suggest and lead a new action

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe participation and expressive movement — evidence for EAD.2.

lessons.title: Phonics Consolidation: Reading Easter Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read simple Easter-themed CVC and digraph words.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all sounds learned this term.
lessons.main_activity: Phonics stations reading Easter-themed word cards (egg, hop, chick) and simple sentences.

differentiation.support: Read simple CVC words with support

lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics application to themed vocabulary — evidence for LIT.2.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading Easter words over the week.

lessons.title: Easter Recap Display
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise key facts about Easter traditions learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Contribute to a class 'Easter Traditions' display combining decorated eggs, bonnets/baskets, and cards made this week.
key_questions: What have we learned about Easter?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's learning — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about Easter with your family.

lessons.title: Easter Celebration Performance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform the week's song/dance with confidence as a celebration.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all elements learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Whole-class performance of the Easter song/dance, with bonnets, baskets, and eggs displayed.
resources_needed: Craft made this week, music player
key_questions: What was your favourite part of this week?
How did it feel to perform?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe confidence and enjoyment — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Round of applause; recap the festive week.
lessons.home_link: Perform the song/dance for family this weekend.

lessons.title: Easter and Spring Quiz Game
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer recall questions about Easter and spring learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Quiz-style game asking questions about Easter traditions and signs of spring from the week.
key_questions: What is a sign of spring?
What do families do at Easter?
lessons.assessment_notes: Assess recall and comprehension — evidence for LIT.1/CL.1.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on Easter and spring facts learned this week.
